disc.definition: point-biserial correlation (item response vs total score)

sd.definition: sample standard deviation of binary responses across LLMs

conversion_formula.ctt_to_irt: NOT POSSIBLE - fundamentally different statistics, must refit from response matrix

reason_cannot_convert: diff/disc are CTT descriptive statistics (corrected proportion-correct and point-biserial correlation), not IRT model parameters. They exist on different scales with different assumptions. Conversion requires refitting an IRT model to the original binary response matrix.

negative_discrimination_items.interpretation: Items where LLMs answering correctly tend to have LOWER total scores. In CTT this means negative item-total correlation; in IRT these would typically be excluded or flagged.

sd_vs_expected.conclusion: sd = sqrt(p*(1-p)*n/(n-1)) confirmed, consistent with binary response sd

sanity_check.note: Max diff=0.689 < 0.75, consistent with diff = 0.75 * p_correct

recommendations_for_dif_analysis: Do NOT use preproc.rds diff/disc as IRT parameters for equating
For IRT-based DIF: extract response matrix from preproc.rds $data slot and refit with mirt
For CTT-based DIF: Mantel-Haenszel or delta-p methods work with raw response data
CTT diff is usable as empirical difficulty proxy for stratification in MH-DIF
The exclude column flags items already screened out by METABENCH's CTT criteria
